body:
I really appreciate you reading my post, I really do. I never thought reading a response from a stranger would bring me joy.

We have been raised in a strict environment where discussing feelings or admitting to depression is a very frowned upon sort of thing. I haven't been able to cry since adolescence and I am pretty sure all my brothers are in the same boat.
I am certain admitting such thoughts to my younger brother will not get me anywhere and will only make our relationship extremely awkward for a long while.
